translation_direction: en → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete English electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Dickens’s comic and retrospective narrator is kept; the grotesque exaggeration and the adult narrator’s irony are carried over without modernising.
decisions.rationale: The book is its comedy and its retrospect.

decisions.decision: The translation covers the complete novel as printed by Gutenberg #1400, the table of contents and 59 chapters, 3893 units.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: A name used before Pip learns it; the address was rendered without the name.
A comic ditty was given invented narration; restored to the sung lines only.
A lyric was paraphrased rather than rendered; restored.
The Jew’s cousin was rendered as the master; corrected.
A possessive given to Herbert instead of Pip; corrected.
“Twenty minutes to nine” read as 8:20; corrected to 8:40.
The convicts were made to treat the guard; the English has them treating him; corrected.
The referent of “it” was given to Estella instead of Miss Havisham’s breast; corrected.
Estella’s correction of Pip was reversed; restored.
A pronoun pointed at the dog instead of the gentleman; corrected.
“Public boarding-school” gave Compeyson the wrong class; corrected.
A young lady was called a matron; corrected.
A bay-window was mistranslated; corrected to the architectural sense.
The refrain sentence was inverted; restored.
“Goes out of his way” reversed; corrected.
A pew-opener was taken for a collector; corrected.
Joe’s “harm” pun has no Vietnamese equivalent; the sense is kept and the pun is recorded as lost.
The pronouns of Pip’s reply were reversed; corrected.
“Come on your birthday” was given Miss Havisham’s birthday instead of Pip’s; corrected.
Pip’s address and self-reference to Mrs. Joe were inconsistent with the glossary; corrected.
Pumblechook’s triumph was reversed; restored.
“Nevvy” lost its nephew sense; corrected.
“Tea for Joe” was given as tea for coffee, and “that strength” had no referent; corrected.
The convict’s sarcasm (“worth my while to murder him”) was reversed; corrected.
Jaggers’s cool formal register was turned into a rustic bully’s; corrected.
“A gross or two” of screws was rendered as a dozen; corrected to the scale of the joke.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: anh (cold lines); Pip (her use of the name)
glossary.rationale: The decided rule for cold speech from Estella to Pip; warm lines are kept warm.
The glossary form; the draft standardises on it.

glossary.draft_rendering: cô Havisham (narration); bà Havisham where the glossary sets it
Satis House (name kept; the pun ‘Enough House’ glossed in translation where it occurs)
glossary.rationale: The name is kept; the pun is translated where it is a pun.

glossary.draft_rendering: rural colloquial Vietnamese without imitation spelling
glossary.rationale: Dialect is kept recognisably rural, not imitated in spelling.

witness_decision: Selected Project Gutenberg #1400, the 1867 edition of Great Expectations. The Gutenberg page does not name every printing detail and the text was not collated with the 1861 serial or the 1862 volume.

title_review.rationale: The title follows the translation’s chosen Vietnamese title, ‘Những Kỳ Vọng Lớn’ (Great Expectations); no other Vietnamese edition was checked.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: The table of contents, rendered as ‘Mục lục’.
The last unit of the witness: the closing paragraph of the novel.
